coverage: safe ordinary and nested record fields with trailing commas
representable narrow integer constants without casts; enums and wide boundaries preserved
union, bitfield and array-member fallback layouts
nonzero literal byte offsets; helper preserves pinned-pool identity
self-referencing global table and global pointer relocations
global and per-owner/per-thread TLS isolation; p/storage alias collisions
static/instance JIT and linux-x64 NativeAOT; forced GC
SQLite core native/JIT/NativeAOT differential parity with test memory VFS and THREADSAFE=0
limitations: No assertion of byte-identical IL or native code.
Full translated EDG compilation/runtime is a separate unverified task.
Runtime validation performed on Linux x64.
